description: This Java class defines an Android Activity called TextUndoActivity, which provides a user interface with multiple EditText fields and buttons to demonstrate text editing operations, including setting, appending, inserting text, restricting input length, and formatting credit card input with spaces. It includes an inner class CreditCardTextWatcher for formatting and validation of credit card number input.

classes.name: TextUndoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating text editing features with undo capabilities.

classes.name: CreditCardTextWatcher
classes.description: A private static inner class that formats credit card input by adding spaces every 4 digits and restricts input to numbers and spaces.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI elements and button click handlers.

methods.name: beforeTextChanged
methods.description: Part of TextWatcher, called before the text is changed.

methods.name: onTextChanged
methods.description: Part of TextWatcher, called as the text is being changed.

methods.name: afterTextChanged
methods.description: Part of TextWatcher, called after the text has been changed, used here to format credit card input.

methods.name: addSpaces
methods.description: Formats a string of digits by inserting spaces every 4 characters.

methods.name: getNumbers
methods.description: Extracts only digits from a CharSequence.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if a character is a digit between '0' and '9'.
